plan.title: Counter offer drawer rejects unchanged and zero-total submissions

steps.note: Open the prepared event's Responses screen with the counter-offer context.
Submit without changing any counter-offer value.

args.text: You must change atleast one column to send counter offer

steps.note: Verify the unchanged counter offer is refused with the expected message.
Verify the rejected unchanged submission sent no additional-request call.
Attempt the no-selected-product submission using the drawer's Send action; the catalog cannot perform the required row unticking before this action.

args.text: Please select atleast one product to send counter offer

steps.note: Verify submission with no selected products is refused.
Verify the rejected no-selection submission sent no additional-request call.
Set the available counter-offer price field to zero as the closest expressible approximation of the zero-total case.

args.text: Gross total can't be 0, please check your entries.

steps.note: Verify the zero-total counter offer is refused with the expected message.
Verify the rejected zero-total submission sent no additional-request call.
cross-check: the screen must show the value the API holds
